newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firmer, NYMEX up briefly on Clinton.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firmer, NYMEX up briefly on Clinton.

text.p: Brent futures were higher in late dealings on Friday amid buying related to the expiry of the April contract, while NYMEX edged up after President Clinton suffered a knee injury.
April NYMEX crude prices edged up nine cents to $20.99 per barrel after news of an injury emerged.
But the price calmed to $20.95 after the White House said Clinton had twisted his knee and the injury was not serious.
The brief flurry higher was within the intraday range of $21.13 to $20.60, after New York had closed at $20.70.
Brokers said April appeared to be hovering around $21.00 ahead of options expiry in New York later on Friday. Call options were actively written at that level on Thursday, brokers said.
Meanwhile, April Brent was pushed higher ahead of the contract's expiry during London trading time.

A European major was active buying the Brent market, brokers said, which included an April/May spread at 50 cents after the spread was assessed at 28 cents late in New York. --Singapore Newsroom (+65 870 3081)
